note: Statements frozen. Lanes fill proof_artifact/exact_checker/counterexample/empirical_bridge/claim_ceiling/status via declared amendments only.

assumptions: zero mandatory overhead for the P1 dominance clause
rows.ocm_residual: whether real H_t inheritance is actually optional-and-free or carries M>0
rows.parent_theorem: superset dominance (trivial order argument); no NFL conflict (fixed tau)
rows.statement: If A_t subset A_{t+1} (every old legal strategy available at unchanged cost), then for any fixed scalarized cost functional C, inf_{a in A_{t+1}} C(a,tau) <= inf_{a in A_t} C(a,tau). With mandatory overhead M only the conditional form survives: future savings > acquisition + maintenance + revision.
rows.title: Optional inheritance monotonicity

assumptions: explicit bounded cost model for the Reach_B form
decidable membership of <O> at finite scope or explicit witness instead
rows.ocm_residual: which real operators are irreducible; finding witnesses in the real grammar
rows.statement: For fixed F,C: if p notin <O> (transformation closure) and p admissible, then <O> strict-subset <O ∪ {p}>. Bounded version: strict Reach_B expansion requires an explicit witness task/state reachable with p within B but not from O within B.
rows.title: Reach expansion by irreducible primitive

assumptions: policy may depend only on phi(s)
rows.ocm_residual: diagnosing aliasing in the real representation (#152 decision regions)
rows.statement: If phi(s1)=phi(s2) but the registered contract requires G(s1) ∩ G(s2) = empty, then no policy measurable w.r.t. phi(s) satisfies the contract on both states. Search cannot repair it: a new channel/distinction/operator is necessary.
rows.title: Representation insufficiency by indistinguishability

assumptions: macro adds no hidden construction cost (charged separately in the overhead-corrected corollary)
rows.ocm_residual: real library construction cost and macro lookup overhead
rows.parent_theorem: Levin search / Solomonoff prior mass; Schmidhuber OOPS incremental bias-optimal search
rows.statement: Under prefix-coded Levin-style allocation where candidate p receives share 2^{-L(p)}, an admitted macro changing a target solution encoding from L to L-Delta (verification and construction cost unchanged) multiplies its prior/search share by 2^Delta. Wall-time improvement remains conditional on scheduler/execution/verification costs.
rows.title: Compression-to-search acceleration under coded search

assumptions: quantities are expectations under the frozen model
rows.ocm_residual: H_eff and invalidation dynamics on real ecologies
rows.statement: Macro m replacing composition s is lifecycle-beneficial on the registered scalar cost coordinate iff H_eff * dC_use > C_build + C_maint + E[C_revision]. Arithmetic once quantities frozen; the science is estimating H_eff and transfer scope prospectively.
rows.title: Macro amortization threshold

assumptions: completeness of declared dependencies for protected outputs
rows.ocm_residual: whether real provenance graphs are complete; cyclic/TMS boundary
rows.parent_theorem: causal DAG intervention locality (Pearl-class d-separation/intervention semantics)
rows.statement: In a complete acyclic dependency DAG whose node values are functions only of declared ancestors, an intervention on S cannot change any node outside Desc(S); exact recomputation outside Desc(S) is unnecessary iff the registered dependency semantics are complete for the protected outputs.
rows.title: Exact dependency-cone locality

assumptions: immutable archive with unlimited capacity (Pareto variant must state capacity effects)
rows.statement: For a fixed evaluator and immutable archive retaining the best-so-far admissible object under a frozen total order, archive best quality is monotone non-decreasing. Proves ONLY a ratchet; not open-endedness/complexity growth/generalization/self-improvement efficiency.
rows.title: Elitist ratchet monotonicity

assumptions: Blackwell dominance (a.s. garbling of E0 from E1)
free information for the dominance clause
rows.ocm_residual: identifying only decision-relevant distinctions (#152); probe pricing on real systems
rows.statement: If experiment E1 Blackwell-dominates E0, then for every Bayesian expected-utility decision problem the optimal value with E1 is >= that with E0 when information is free. With probe cost, buy information only when expected decision improvement exceeds cost.
rows.title: Information dominance / decision sufficiency

assumptions: sample sizes per parent bound conditions
rows.ocm_residual: the OCM finite morphology/operator-bias class specialization (lane D)
rows.parent_theorem: Baxter JAIR 2000; Maurer-Pontil-Romera-Paredes JMLR 2016; Alquier-Mai-Pontil 2017; PAC-Bayes meta-bounds
rows.statement: Under Baxter/Maurer-class assumptions (related tasks sampled from an environment, controlled hypothesis-space family), bias learned on sufficiently many tasks generalizes to new tasks from the same environment; PAC-Bayes/lifelong regret bounds hold under explicit distributional assumptions. No theorem over arbitrary future domains.
rows.title: Learned inductive bias can generalize, conditionally

assumptions: finite candidate space for the P2 form
rows.ocm_residual: estimating Ev on real lineages; continued-vs-reset kernel comparison (#217/#221)
rows.parent_theorem: innovation/evolvability measures in QD literature (useful-novelty rates)
rows.statement: Ev_t(x; U, D) = P_{x prime ~ Q_t(.|x)}[admissible and useful under U]. Exactly enumerable at finite scope; generalization to unseen ecologies needs P3 assumptions. HST claim form: Ev_{t+1} > Ev_t or lower first-useful-change burden, not higher current fitness.
rows.title: Evolvability as useful-descendant mass

rows.ocm_residual: whether real development discovers such modules
rows.parent_theorem: grammar compression / module acquisition cost models (DreamCoder-class; MDL)
rows.statement: If a repeatedly instantiated subgraph M behind an interface preserving registered external semantics reduces total description+execution+search cost after charging module definition+interface+maintenance, then promoting M to a higher-level unit is a valid compression/search transformation. Conditional economic criterion only; cannot prove spontaneous emergence of major transitions.
rows.title: Cognitive major-transition compression criterion

rows.parent_theorem: pigeonhole; Adams et al. 2017 formal OEE; MODES 2019 metrics
rows.statement: A closed deterministic finite-state system must eventually repeat; literal infinite non-repeating state novelty is impossible for fixed finite closed state space. Open-endedness must be horizon-scoped, relative to recurrence baselines, or the effective space must expand.
rows.title: Finite-state literal open-endedness limit

rows.statement: For any finite observed trajectory prefix, absent a fully specified/proved transition law, there exist both a bounded-continuation and a continuing-novelty continuation consistent with the prefix; finite observation cannot prove unbounded open-endedness.
rows.title: No finite trajectory proves unbounded future novelty

assumptions: NFL assumptions exactly: closed-under-permutation problem class, uniform distribution over problems
non-assumptions must be listed: structured ecologies escape NFL
rows.ocm_residual: which structured-ecology assumptions OCM can actually register
rows.statement: Under NFL conditions (closure over the problem class, uniform averaging), no search/transformation dominates; HST must target conditional bias adaptation + regime-change detection, not a universal best mutation/search algorithm.
rows.title: No universally best fixed search transformation

assumptions: consistent sufficiently expressive axiom system for Gödel part
rows.ocm_residual: C must expose bounded decidable contracts + protected validation + CANNOT_CHECK
rows.parent_theorem: Rice; Turing; Gödel; Schmidhuber Gödel Machines (conditional form)
rows.statement: Rice/halting/Gödel: nontrivial semantic properties of arbitrary programs are undecidable; sufficiently expressive consistent formal systems contain true-unprovable statements. Universal complete proof that arbitrary self-change is beneficial is unavailable. Gödel-Machine optimality is conditional on finding/proving the target theorem.
rows.title: No complete general semantic self-improvement verifier

rows.ocm_residual: none for the limit itself; bars final-architecture claims
rows.statement: Blum speedup: computable problems exist with no asymptotically optimal program under admissible complexity measures. HST cannot promise convergence to a final globally fastest cognition; supports continuing search-transformation pressure in some families.
rows.title: No universal fastest solver/self-improver

assumptions: writable score register identical to target
rows.ocm_residual: whether the real C is independent/complete/robust (formal-by-contract + empirical)
rows.parent_theorem: Goodhart-class misalignment folk results; here as constructed toy theorem
rows.statement: If an optimizer can directly rewrite a scalar score register that is itself the optimization target and no independent constraint ties the score to protected world performance, then a score-maximizing self-change can raise measured objective without improving protected performance. NOT a claim that external C is sufficient for safe self-improvement.
rows.title: External-evaluator anti-self-certification (toy)

rows.statement: If scalar burden >= b_min and each generation must improve by >= epsilon > 0, at most (B_0 - b_min)/epsilon such improvements exist. Indefinite fixed-size improvement requires shrinking epsilon, expanding scope/frontier, new dimensions, or regime change; bars defining open-ended self-improvement as fixed-epsilon gains on one frozen finite benchmark.
rows.title: Fixed-epsilon bounded-burden improvement limit
